array.string: [ "$(TZ=America/Chicago date +%Y-%m-%d)" = "2026-11-22" ] || exit 0; U=$(id -u); while read j; do launchctl enable gui/$U/$j; done < $HOME/.config/paused-2026-11-21.txt; echo "$(date) resumed $(wc -l < $HOME/.config/paused-2026-11-21.txt) jobs paused 21 Nov" >> $HOME/.config/paused-2026-11-21.log
